package rulefixtures

import (
	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for unscoped_query_without_explicit_danger_naming: `Unscoped()` usage in generic repository methods without a clearly dangerous or admin-only name.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type User struct {
	ID   int
	Name string
	gorm.Model
}

func DeleteUser(db *gorm.DB, id int) error {
	return db.Unscoped().Delete(&User{}, id).Error
}

func PurgeUserData(db *gorm.DB, userID int) error {
	return db.Unscoped().Where("user_id = ?", userID).Delete(&User{}).Error
}
